svg.title: GridGuard system architecture and enforced trust boundary
svg.desc: A verified local telemetry path runs from controlled grid scenarios through the power simulator and Modbus TCP ingestor into InfluxDB and Grafana. The ingestor is the only component allowed to cross from cloud-core into the isolated OT simulation zone. Direct OT-to-database access and deployment outside the CI gate are blocked. AWS infrastructure is defined in Terraform but has not been applied.
svg.text: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE / VERIFIED PATH + DEPLOYMENT INTENT
One controlled bridge between simulated OT and telemetry operations
The local path is exercised end to end. AWS resources remain unapplied, cost-gated Terraform.
APPROVED DELIVERY ROAD / PULL REQUEST + REQUIRED CI GATE + MANUAL CLOUD APPLY
runtime, endpoints, NAT, public ALB, and OIDC are off by default
Source of truth: compose.yaml + Terraform · validated at a54770d
